# Clementine Ainslie

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-thirties  <sub>[v4 c8 P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 c11 P21](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v4 c8 P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Music teacher  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Ainslie  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>; Miss Clementine

## Appearance

Clementine is a tall, fair, and remarkably beautiful woman with a rose-leaf complexion, serene blue eyes, a high pale brow, and thick, shiny golden-brown hair worn in smooth, tight braids. Inheriting her mother's beauty, she possesses a graceful, elegant figure and a gentle, sweet countenance that retains a youthful charm despite her years.

_Sources: [v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 c11 P21](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0021), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v5 c2 P21](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0021), [v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031)_

## Personality

Clementine is an exceptionally sweet, gentle, and patient woman known throughout the Glen for her quiet dignity and unfailing kindness. Though she harbors a deep capacity for romance and love, she possesses an unyielding sense of honor and loyalty that leads her to keep solemn promises even at great personal cost. She is deeply empathetic toward children and has an understanding nature that easily wins their affection.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P32](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0032), [v5 c2 P21](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0021), [v5 c2 P22](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0022), [v5 c2 P35](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0035), [v5 c13 P24](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0024)_

## History

Clementine Ainslie grew up in an Episcopalian home on a hill overlooking Glen St. Agnes, suffering the early loss of her father and brother. At seventeen, she fell in love with young Martin Crawford, but he drowned at sea shortly thereafter. Following her mother's death when Clementine was twenty-five, she swore a solemn oath over the Bible to her grief-stricken sister Harriet that she would never marry and leave her alone. She lived quietly for years at the old family homestead, giving music lessons to local children. Later in life, she met the widowed Presbyterian minister John Ashdown at a forest spring. Although they fell in love, she initially refused his proposal of marriage due to her vow to Harriet. Eventually, Harriet released her from the oath upon deciding to marry her own former suitor, Lionel Fairlie. Clementine subsequently accepted Mr. Ashdown, winning the devotion of his four motherless children.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 c13 P1](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0001), [v5 c13 P14](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0014), [v5 c13 P23](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0023), [v5 c13 P24](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0024), [v5 c13 P28](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0028), [v5 c13 P38](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0038), [v5 c14 P23](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0023), [v5 c14 P34](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0034), [v5 c14 P38](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0038)_
